Breaking it down:
- "any driver below 75 laps" means drivers who completed fewer than 75 laps.
- "care trouble of some kind" likely means "had trouble of some kind" (like retirement reasons).
- "thus no time listed" means that because of trouble, they don't have a finish time in the "time / retired" column (instead, they have a retirement reason).
- "12 drivers below 75 laps" claims there are 12 such drivers.

Now, look at the table:
- The "laps" column shows laps completed.
- The "time / retired" column shows either a finish time (like "1:47:35.5") or a retirement reason (like "engine", "accident", etc.).
